environment.host_storage:
sda     WDC WDS250G1B0A-00H9H0 232.9G    0
sdb     WDC WD10EZEX-22MFCA0   931.5G    1
nvme0n1 CSL_Virt_MN_01           7.5G    0
environment.emulated_device: NVMeVirt conventional SSD, RAM-backed, memmap_start=4G memmap_size=8192M, 4 FTL partitions
environment.nvmevirt_base: oyeong011/nvmevirt fork (see repo), conv FTL; iCAT sources online-mix-src / online-v2-src / online-v4-src

make_flags.kbuild_ccflags: ccflags-y += -Wno-unused-variable -Wno-unused-function ccflags-$(CONFIG_NVMEVIRT_NVM) += -DBASE_SSD=INTEL_OPTANE ccflags-$(CONFIG_NVMEVIRT_SSD) += -DBASE_SSD=SAMSUNG_970PRO ccflags-y += -DCONV_GC_POLICY=0 ccflags-y += -DCONV_GC_POLICY=1 ccflags-y += -DCONV_GC_POLICY=2 ccflags-$(CONFIG_NVMEVIRT_ZNS) += -DBASE_SSD=WD_ZN540 ccflags-$(CONFIG_NVMEVIRT_ZNS) += -Wno-implicit-fallthrough ccflags-$(CONFIG_NVMEVIRT_KV) += -DBASE_SSD=KV_PROTOTYPE

workload: mixY prep (6 GiB FIO file: 128k seq write + 3 GiB 4k randwrite) then FIO-Fast test4 for 1800 s; workloads/mix-test4.fio

order.waf_check: F-noinstr v1 v2 v4 (uninstrumented, 1 run each)

measurement_window: from `start` written to /proc/nvmevirt_measurement (started.txt mtime) to `stop` (stopped.txt mtime); counters accumulate only while active
